map.市场（比较法）案例修正 使用指南: Market (Comparison Approach) Case Adjustment User Guide
map.输入多个可比案例成交价及各类修正系数，自动计算每个案例的比准价格并加权得到估价对: Enter the transaction prices of several comparable cases together with the adjustment factors; the tool computes each case's adjusted unit price and weights them into a reference unit price for the subject property.
map.案例修正 = 可比价×因素修正: Case adjustment = comparable price × factor adjustments
map.填写「案例 A 成交价（元/㎡）」。: Enter the "transaction price of case A (CNY/m²)".
map.填写「案例 B 成交价（元/㎡）」。: Enter the "transaction price of case B (CNY/m²)".
map.填写「案例 C 成交价（元/㎡，选填）」。: Enter the "transaction price of case C (CNY/m², optional)".
map.多个可比案例按交易/市场/区域/实物因素修正。: Adjust multiple comparable cases by transaction, market, location, and physical factors.
map.加权求估价对象参考单价。: Weight them to get the reference unit price of the subject property.
map.对比等权与按修正幅度加权的结果。: Compare the equal-weighted result with the result weighted by adjustment magnitude.
map.单案例比准价: Adjusted unit price from a single case
map.：案例 A 成交价 8500 元/㎡，交易情况 +2%、市场状况 +1%、区域因: : Case A transaction price 8500 CNY/m², with transaction situation +2%, market condition +1%, location factor −1%, and physical factor +3% → adjusted unit price = 8500×(1.02)(1.01)(0.99)(1.03)≈8930 CNY/m².
map.：案例 A/B/C 比准价约 8930/9380/9010，等权平均≈9107: : The adjusted unit prices of cases A/B/C are about 8930/9380/9010, with an equal-weighted average of ≈9107 CNY/m²; weighting by adjustment magnitude moves the reference unit price slightly, so take the midpoint of the range as the valuation basis.

map.修正系数怎么来？: Where Do the Correction Factors Come From?
map.逐项对比估价对象与案例的差异（楼层、朝向、装修、时点等）量化成百分比，正为加负为: Compare the subject property with a case item by item (floor, orientation, fit-out, timing, and so on) and quantify each as a percentage, positive to add and negative to subtract.
map.案例少时怎么办？: What If There Are Few Cases?
map.至少 3 个可比案例，不足时放宽范围或改用收益/成本法，并在报告中说明案例局限性: At least 3 comparable cases are needed; if there are fewer, widen the search range or switch to the income or cost approach, and state the case limitations in the report.
